status: frozen locally after known-case development and before new validation; no external registry
purpose: Test a causal hybrid of balance-based recovery and finite stress-risk penalties against harmful inaction, while adding six nested realism regimes and preserving dropped-work accounting.

scenario_design.families: All eleven prior scenario families; preserve source slices and each family without outcome-based removal.
scenario_design.original_horizon: 60 minutes for legacy families; 96 minutes for generated families.

development.status: Known v0.3 validation cases now openly reused for development. All v0.3 outcomes are known evidence, not fresh validation.

validation.status: Reserved seeds. No controller outcomes may be evaluated before final source/configuration freeze.

nested_regimes.name: legacy_instant
nested_regimes.addition: Original fluid, same-minute serial service; zero resource transfer delay.

nested_regimes.name: legacy_transit3
nested_regimes.addition: Resource transfer loses exactly three complete service intervals.

nested_regimes.name: integer_transit3
nested_regimes.addition: Integer resource allocations by stable largest-remainder projection of raw catalogue targets; service and workload remain continuous fluid.

nested_regimes.name: finite_pipeline
nested_regimes.addition: One full interval of forwarding between stages and finite stage buffers [60000,40000,40000]. Overflow is explicit dropped work, never erased from demand deficit.

nested_regimes.name: startup
nested_regimes.addition: Incoming resource service at 50% and 75% during the first two active intervals after the three-interval transfer.

nested_regimes.name: delayed_noisy
nested_regimes.addition: Sensor lag of two intervals and 5% lognormal multiplicative sensor noise. The exact packet timing, channel treatment and stochastic streams must be frozen before validation.

policy_information_boundary: Only the declared observation interface, known mechanics, resource commands and causal history are available. No true future arrivals/productivity, hidden scenario identity, validation outcome or offline static counterfactual is an online input. Censored flow is not treated as exact service capacity.

resource_model.catalogue: Original frozen action catalogue, including hold; no overlapping transfers.
resource_model.loss_units: resource_minutes_lost counts pending resources only; startup_capacity_minutes_lost counts active minus effective resources. Keep original and follow-up totals separate, in resource-minutes, without monetary interpretation.

followup.productivity: Fixed at the last original-horizon true productivity row.
followup.information: The controller is not told original H or the future follow-up switch.
followup.drainage: Physical drainage uses retained queues plus in-flight work; permanent drops are not cleared jobs. A nonzero demand deficit caused by drops need not imply physical retained work remains.

scoring.per_minute_deficit: D_t = cumulative offered work minus cumulative completed work = retained queued work + in-flight work + cumulative dropped work.
scoring.primary_case_metric: M = mean of end-of-minute D_t over original H only; no normalization by completed or accepted work.
scoring.static_relative_harm: h_p = max(M_p - M_static, 0) for the same scenario and realism regime.
scoring.cvar90: R_p is the exact empirical mean over the largest 10% of h_p, with fractional mass at the boundary. Compare R_p values using the same paired bootstrap, not CVaR of candidate-minus-comparator harms.
scoring.required_loss_reporting: Report original and follow-up offered/completed/dropped separately and full-run totals. A finite buffer cannot improve the score by discarding work.
scoring.endpoints: Report original terminal deficit, follow-up deficit mean/AUC/end, retained queue and in-flight work, physical capped drainage time and censoring.
scoring.definitions: mean_queue/end_queue/tail_end_queue include retained service queues plus forwarding pipeline. peak_service_queue_max_over_full_run is max_t of the SUM of service queues over original plus follow-up, excluding pipeline; end_inflight_work and tail_end_inflight_work are scalar pipeline sums.

analysis.bootstrap: Paired percentile resampling of scenario cases within each family; all policies use the same resampled indices. Regimes remain separate.
analysis.weighting: Equal case weights with equal counts per family; this does not normalize workload scale.
analysis.regime_handling: Six nested regimes analyzed separately, without pooling them into one headline effect or treating them as independent replications.
analysis.noninferiority: Use the declared linear slack statistic 1.05*mean(baseline)-mean(candidate), including zero baselines; do not substitute a confidence interval for a different ratio statistic.
analysis.sources: Report both legacy_flash and generated_synthetic slices and all eleven families.
analysis.interval_scope: Conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty for the declared synthetic workload and mechanics; not real-system uncertainty, calibrated forecast confidence, or a deployment guarantee.

acceptance_criteria.status: Declared and accepted by root before any v0.4 development outcomes; fixed throughout development and validation.

primary.metric: static-relative positive-harm CVaR90 of original-H mean demand deficit
primary.condition: paired-bootstrap lower endpoint of the 95% CI for R_v3_full minus R_v4_hybrid is strictly greater than zero
primary.point_when_both_zero: This superiority criterion does not pass merely because both risks are zero.

risk_point_nonworsening.condition: R_v4_hybrid <= R_baseline + tolerance_absolute in every regime for every listed baseline
risk_point_nonworsening.scope: Engineering point checks, not statistical tail-risk noninferiority claims; no positive risk margin.

mean_noninferiority.condition: paired-bootstrap lower endpoint of the 95% CI for the statistic is >= 0 in every regime for each baseline, within tolerance_absolute
mean_noninferiority.scope: The same candidate is compared separately with both fixed baselines; do not choose the empirically best baseline after outcomes.

loss_and_endpoint_point_nonworsening.condition: candidate point mean <= baseline point mean + tolerance_absolute in each regime, for each metric and baseline

metric_scopes.total_dropped: all original H plus the fixed 32-minute follow-up
metric_scopes.tail_auc_deficit: sum of offered-minus-completed deficit over the fixed 32 follow-up minutes

integrity.condition: All required unit tests, frozen identities, full episode accounting, source/sensor/observation boundary audit, paired scope checks, and independent representative replay checks pass.

underload.condition: Every underload case in every regime has zero dropped work and zero moves over original H plus follow-up, within tolerance_absolute
underload.scope: Retained work, pipeline work and demand deficit may be positive due to declared flow timing; zero backlog is not required.

acceptance_criteria.advancement: Every primary, risk point, mean noninferiority, loss/endpoint, integrity and underload condition must pass. Report every failed condition. Criteria cannot be relaxed using development or validation outcomes.
acceptance_criteria.inference_scope: One predeclared primary CVaR comparison in the final realism regime. The global decision also uses the listed engineering intersection and mean-noninferiority checks. Secondary, source, family and ablation intervals are descriptive and unadjusted; no universal safety or deployment claim.

no_tuning: Freeze controller/environment/metrics/evaluator/configuration/manifest/source hashes before reserved outcomes. No acceptance change during development or validation. Any post-validation change requires a new version and new held-out design.

development_grid.selection_scope: All 88 known development scenarios in all six regimes. Retain outcomes for every grid member; no fresh-seed outcome is available to selection.
lexicographic_ranking: Count of point-mean margin violations across 6 regimes and both capacity_v2/capacity_balance: mean_hybrid > 1.05*mean_baseline + 1e-6.
Maximum over 6 regimes of R_hybrid / max(min(R_v3_full,R_capacity_v2,R_capacity_balance),1 work unit).
Sum over the 6 regimes of R_hybrid.
Mean original-H moves across all known cases and regimes.
development_grid.scope_warning: This cross-regime ordering and one-unit denominator floor are development selection rules only, never pooled headline effects, calibrated losses or validation acceptance rules.
development_grid.bootstrap: Point outcomes suffice for the fixed selection ordering. The selected development candidate and validation summary use the frozen 2000-draw analysis.

controller_semantics.status: Specified before development outcomes; final selected grid values and implementation hashes remain pending freeze.
controller_semantics.state: One shared estimator/history/resource command state and one dwell clock; do not hot-switch independently advancing stateful controllers.
controller_semantics.forecasts: Sixteen steps; nine base design forecasts and 24 independent stage-rate stress corners. Known transfer/startup/pipeline mechanics are predicted. Engineering scenarios are not calibrated probability samples.
controller_semantics.score: Mean base-nine cost improvement versus hold minus lambda times the upper-quartile mean of positive stress-corner regret. Forecast cost is mean predicted deficit plus 0.5 times terminal deficit; there is no separate terminal hard veto.
controller_semantics.hurdle: max(10 work units,0.01*mean recent observed arrival), with the declared recovery attenuation when applicable; it is tied to flow, not backlog stock.
controller_semantics.catalogue: Evaluate the complete legal original catalogue subject to a declared maximum total transfer of20 or30 resource units per move, defined as the sum of positive deltas. Both raw and integer-projected applied deltas must satisfy the cap. Explicitly evaluate the inverse-estimated-rate capacity-balance proposal among legal capped candidates.
controller_semantics.arbitration: Prefer the balance-directed proposal when its positive adjusted gain is at least 90% of the best positive adjusted gain and clears the applicable hurdle.
controller_semantics.stale_observations: The previous busy-rate lower anchor expires after eight source minutes. Removing a stale low anchor can narrow the interval. Sparse evidence and sensor lag separately widen the point-relative band. Recent evidence uses a five-observation window. Prior reversion remains an explicit estimator assumption, not observed recovery.
controller_semantics.pressure_recovery: For persistent observed pressure with total end queue above10 work units and target-allocation imbalance of at least5 resource units (half L1 distance), multiply both the risk weight and hurdle by max(0.25,1/(1+pressure_streak/8)). The streak permits a decline of at most max(10 work units,2% of the previous observed queue), so it includes nearly flat or slightly declining queues. Physical constraints are unchanged.
controller_semantics.idle_recovery: After three consecutive delivered end-queue observations with total measured queue <=10 work units, allow a balance-directed move only if the mean cost across the nine base forecasts does not increase and none of all33 forecasts increases cost by more than10 work units. This permits a model-neutral return under low observed queue pressure without requiring strictly positive gain.
controller_semantics.v4_no_risk: Only the stress-score penalty weight is set to zero; physical constraints and idle-recovery checks remain.
controller_semantics.v4_no_recovery: Both pressure-recovery attenuation and idle-rebalance recovery are disabled. This is a combined recovery ablation, not an isolation of one component.
controller_semantics.hard_constraints: Keep resource budget, reserve, catalogue, warmup, dwell, and physical movement timing hard. A model stress test is not a formal safety proof.

research_basis.title: Adaptive Policies for Scheduling with Reconfiguration Delay: An End-to-End Solution for All-Optical Data Centers
research_basis.relevance: Motivates candidate-versus-current improvement thresholds that account for reconfiguration overhead. Its network stability theorem is not asserted for this ANS model.

research_basis.title: Delay-Optimal Scheduling for Queueing Systems with Switching Overhead
research_basis.authors: Ping-Chun Hsieh, I-Hong Hou and Xi Liu
research_basis.relevance: Motivates modeling lost service during switching and a controlled bias toward the current allocation. Its parallel-queue assumptions and guarantees do not establish ANS performance.

research_basis.title: Linear robust adaptive model predictive control: Computational complexity and conservatism
research_basis.authors: Johannes Koehler, Elisa Andina, Raffaele Soloperto, Matthias A. Mueller and Frank Allgoewer
research_basis.relevance: Motivates separating point-estimate performance from uncertainty handling and using recent observations. ANS stress weights are uncalibrated engineering choices, not this paper's robust constraint guarantee.

representative_selection: First scenario seed in every family, for every deterministic policy and each of six regimes; 462 complete traces and 51576 original-plus-followup minutes selected before outcomes.
workflow: Original Neuron Flow runtime; 42 regime/policy evaluation steps with three workers and a comparison join; descriptor-only artifact exchange; first-attempt legacy_instant/v4_hybrid transient failure before policy computation; restart/duplicate reuse; separate completed+1 static corruption rejected with dependent branch blocked and independent branch successful.
boundary: Policy inputs contain current commanded resources and timestamped observations; declared sensor lag and startup use historical same-source effective resources. True environment arrays, common future noise and terminal schedule remain outside the controller.
no_tuning_rule: No controller, configuration, generator, sensor, metric or acceptance changes after inspecting validation outcomes. A subsequent change is a new experiment.
